data.name: Fork It!
data.detailed_description:
Do You Have What It Takes To Become Forklift Certified?

Fork It! is a brutal, physics based journey where you are put behind the wheel of a forklift. Navigate with precision through hazardous industrial environments where around every corner is an obstacle ready to catch you out. begin your journey in the warehouse and prove you deserve to be forklift certified by retrieving the flag at the summit of the mountain. However things wont be so simple, as you'll come to find out!

Features

Multiple Endings

Multiple ways for your certification to come to its conclusion whether that's passing, failing or discovering paths onwards.

Semi-Realistic Forklift Physics

From rear wheel steering to the full functionality of the forks you can test your skills on a lifelike forklift to see if you have what it takes to complete the Certification.

3 strikes and you're out! 

Any damage to your company issued forklift will result in an immediate strike being issued! After the 3rd strike is issued your certification is over and you will meet an explosive end.

Forklift Customisation

Customise your forklift with 6 base colours and discover many more Hidden cosmetics unlocked throughout your adventure.

A Diverse World to explore, and many secrets to find.

Experience a wacky journey upward proving that you can handle the diverse zones that scale in absurdity from a grounded start in the warehouse to uncovering a hidden plot by aliens and continuing your investigation on into the heart of their mothership, with many secrets to be discovered through all parts of your journey.

Fork It! blends grounded machinery with escalating absurdity, delivering a rage fuelled experience that's equal parts stressful and satisfying. 

Survive The Course.

Get Certified.

Or Fail Trying.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8600l or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 Or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
